title: Lighthouse integration weekly spotcheck - 2026-08-05
content:
Date: 2026-08-05
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Duration: 45m (standing sync)
Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Hannah, Devon, Priya, customer reps (NovaHealth: Sam T., FinSight: Li W.), SE shadow: Oliver

Goal: Quick checkpoint across active integrations (Lighthouse cohort), capture drift/risk, unblock rollouts for next week. Keep this tight — escalate any customer-impacting items to SRE/infra triage.

Agenda:
- Rapid customer statuses (5–7m each)
- Open technical risks and mitigations
- Rollout schedule for Dedicated capacity and fallback plan
- Action items and owners

1) Customer snapshots (heatmap-style comments)
- NovaHealth (prod pilot):
  - Current: Canary traffic at ~20% across two routes, latency within target but 95th tail creeping up to 420ms for long-context prompts.
  - Recent incident: KV cache invalidation observed after model autoswap during nightly jobs (PROSERV-421). Root cause: cache key namespace mismatch between model variant v2a and v2b leading to cold KVs and token regen.
  - Impact: Small increase in token cost for affected requests, customer-facing retries observed (3% of requests).
  - Next steps: Patch deployed to canary yesterday (Marco). Need verification by end of day 2026-08-06. If green, schedule full rollout to remaining routes on 2026-08-10.
  - Ask to infra: Add short-term metric for 'kv_miss_rate_by_variant' to console dashboard. Owner: Hannah.

- MarketMuse (staging -> dedicated trial):
  - Current: Staging tests pass; dedicated cluster provisioning hitting quota limits in target region (us-west-2).
  - Operational note: Procurement requested GPU flavor change from A10 to A100 due to throughput needs — cost delta evaluated in sheet attached to Confluence runbook.
  - Risk: Provisioning delay could push trial start by 5 business days. Options: temp fallback to hosted with traffic steering, or approve A100 purchase.
  - Owner to CC: Priya to coordinate with sales/procurement and infra (ticket INFRA-332).

- FinSight (early integration):
  - Current: Data pipeline ingest completed. End-to-end run with private deployment failed at model validation step due to quantization mismatch (int8 build vs expected int4).
  - Temporary workaround: Use unquantized variant on private node (higher memory/cost) until quantized build validated.
  - Action: Devon and applied-ml to run compatibility matrix and produce a validation script. Target: 2026-08-09.

2) Technical risks & notes\- KV cache bug detail: repro steps added to PROSERV-421; workaround is a soft-restart of the serving process which rehydrates KVs but causes brief latency spike. We should avoid soft-restarts during peak windows.
- Autoswap policy: current canary autoswap triggers on deployment success without explicit KV namespace migration. Proposal: add a migration hook that copies/renames KV namespaces prior to swap. Risk: slight increase in deployment time but avoids customer token regen. Owner: Marco + serving-runtime.
- Dedicated capacity scheduling: autoscaler config for reserved pools is currently conservative; recommend temporary increase in burst capacity for Lighthouse cohort for the next 3 weeks. Cost estimate attached to Confluence. Owner: Priya.
- Observability gaps: missing per-variant token-cost breakdown in console for private deployments. Hannah to draft an instrumentation ticket.

3) Rollout schedule & fallback policies\- NovaHealth: Full route rollout targeted 2026-08-10 if canary verification passes by 2026-08-06. Fallback: instant traffic steering to hosted stable model variant for affected endpoints.\- MarketMuse: start dedicated trial provisioning 2026-08-07; contingency: begin hosted-steering if capacity not ready by 2026-08-12.\- FinSight: hold on private cutover until quant validation script passes (target 2026-08-09). If delayed beyond 2026-08-14, propose phased cutover with monitoring gates.

4) Action items (abbreviated)
- Marco: monitor canary KV patch metrics; confirm 'kv_miss_rate_by_variant' < 0.5% by 2026-08-06 EOD. (owner)
- Hannah: add console metric ticket and short dashboard; link to runbook; due 2026-08-07. (owner)
- Priya: coordinate A100 vs fallback procurement decision and update INFRA-332; due 2026-08-09. (owner)
- Devon: produce quantization compatibility script and validation matrix for FinSight; due 2026-08-09. (owner)
- Oliver (SE): draft customer-facing note for NovaHealth describing KV behavior and mitigation; sync with legal for tone; due 2026-08-06 AM.
- Aisha: compile this week's risk items and put on Friday AM leadership readout if any customer is at RED.

5) Quick retrospective items (notes-to-self / informal)
- Meeting cadence: keep 45m but split into 2 shorter dives for deep technical triage to avoid overloading customers.
- Docs: need a 'quick triage checklist' for KV cache incidents that can be run by on-call SE before escalating to SRE. Draft in Confluence.
- Template: create one-pager 'customer-impact rubric' for what counts as P1/P2 for integrations (helps PS and SRE align).

Open questions (unresolved)
- Can autoswap include a fast-namespace-copy without doubling storage pressure? Infra to advise.
- For dedicated trials, can we pre-reserve burst capacity across regional pools for approved customers? Finance approval pending.

Meeting notes archived to: Confluence runbook (linked above) and ticket PROSERV-421.

Raw meeting transcript: (internal) minimal — Marco called out a regression in KV namespace mapping; Priya flagged procurement timeout; Devon requested extra headroom for quant testing.

Next sync: 2026-08-12 (standard Wednesday cadence). Please update tickets and Confluence before EOD 2026-08-06 so we can validate statuses in the next sync.

-- End of notes --
